note: Official Blooket product updates. Exact times unknown unless noted.

entries.title: Season 8 launches
entries.body: Dog Pack (25 tokens), Claw Mania (live), Snake Escape (solo), Class Pass, Achievements, Locker, and Arcade.

entries.title: Fuego Unique in Market
entries.body: Fuego (Design a Blook Contest winner) available as a limited Unique (about May 20 – June 2, 2026).

entries.title: Design a Blook Contest
entries.body: Contest period that led to the Fuego Unique.

entries.title: Major Market redesign
entries.body: Smaller pack icons, price under packs, multi-buy flow. Instant-open removed.

entries.title: Season 7 — Mining
entries.body: Busy Bees, Mini Mine, Zorblitz, Star Grazer. Lunch Pack added. Pirate's Voyage removed.

entries.title: Crazy Kingdom rework
entries.body: Visual and UI rework to match other modes.

entries.title: Blooks page redesign
entries.body: Blooks page updated including Blook points display.

entries.title: Season 6 — Retro
entries.body: Laser Tag, Study, Plushie Panic, Coco Cabana, Pirate Pool. Bug Pack added. Tower of Doom removed.

entries.title: Crazy Kingdom bonus removed
entries.body: Extra token/XP bonus on Crazy Kingdom removed.

entries.title: Spooky Pack (Season 6 window)
entries.body: Halloween seasonal pack. Typical window early October through early November.

entries.title: Season 5 — Pirate
entries.body: Pirate Pack, Pirate's Voyage, Contest of Candy 2023.

entries.title: October 2022 visual redesign
entries.body: Site-wide redesign, new Market look, Weekly Shop. Exact day unknown.

entries.title: Season 4 — Monsters
entries.body: Boxes renamed to Packs. Ice Monster Pack, Monster Brawl, Tower Defense 2.

entries.title: Season 3 — Aquatic
entries.body: Aquatic Pack, Fishing Frenzy, Contest of Candy 2021.

entries.title: Season 2 — Breakfast
entries.body: Breakfast Pack, Cafe and related modes, first Contest of Candy.

entries.title: Season 1 / site launch
entries.body: Blooket launches. Medieval, Bot, and Space packs. Classic and early modes.
